lines.en: I walk lightly in the flower forest.
I keep to the grassy paths between flowers.
My green mane brushes the flowers.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛盛开的玫瑰。
lines.en: I go round a clump of roses.

lines.zh: 我沿着风袭森林的边线走。
lines.en: I walk the edge of the windswept forest.
I step softly on the loam.

lines.zh: 我朝锚点那边回到位置。
lines.en: I return toward my anchor.
I walk slowly into the tree shade.
Now and then I lower my head to the flowers.
I turn and keep walking.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过来的方向看。
lines.en: I look toward where you're coming from.
I stop again and listen.
I stand among the flowers.

lines.zh: 我的绿色鬃毛在风里动。
lines.en: My green mane moves in the wind.
I wait for my trainer's orders.
Petals settle on my back.
Petals settle into my mane.

lines.zh: 我鼓鼓的身子，藏着一点圣光。
lines.en: This round body holds a little holy light.
I look up at the sky.

lines.zh: 一缕光从我鬃毛上滑下。
lines.en: A thread of light slides off my mane.
I stay still as a stone.
Dew still hangs on the stems.
I'm counting the passing butterflies.

lines.zh: 这花丛里没有一点动静。
lines.en: Nothing stirs in these flowers.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖鬃毛上的花瓣。
lines.en: I shake petals from my mane.
I raise my eyes ahead again.
Have you come to take me along?
I look up at you, quiet.

lines.zh: 你的手掌摊开，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Your palm opens; I sniff it.
You smell of flowers.
I turn an ear to your voice.
I won't hide, and I'm not afraid.
May I sit beside you?
Call me and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我把爪子搭在你的鞋上。
lines.en: I rest a paw on your shoe.
Will you be my partner?

lines.zh: 我发出一声轻轻的低鸣。
lines.en: I give a soft, low sound.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，我退半步。
lines.en: Your shadow falls; I back half a step.

lines.zh: 我的绿色鬃毛扫着花，跟你走。
lines.en: My green mane brushes flowers as I follow you.
I keep my eyes on you a while.
You carry the sun's warmth.
I lean my head gently over.
I step back and cry out softly.
A stripe across my back; the green fur lifts.
I look at you, a little confused.
I can bear this pain.
I shake petals from my mane.
I dive into the thickest flowers.
My green glow flickers unevenly.
Something runs down my leg: light.
I'll remember this.
I slowly get up again.
Is that for me?
I walk over and sniff.

lines.zh: 绿色的软糖兽，专射圣光。
lines.en: A green Pucchiemon only shoots holy light.
I eat in small bites.
I look up at you mid-chew.
When you crouch, I relax.
Is this enough?
These berries taste faintly sweet.
Green fur, soft to hold.
I like this taste a lot.
I nuzzle into your hand.

lines.zh: 绿色的我，谢谢你这份饲料。
lines.en: Green as I am, thank you for the feed.
You touched me and I yielded half a step.
My fur is soft, not prickly.

lines.zh: 我绿得像一片叶子，可我会飞。
lines.en: Green as a leaf, and I fly.
We knocked petals loose.
I stand pressed to you.
I retreat behind the flowers.
I steady myself and don't fall.
That bump was nothing.
I step back to my spot by the flowers.
I shake the flowers off.

lines.zh: 另一只绿色的身影靠近。
lines.en: Another green shape comes near.

lines.zh: 我们的鬃毛一起在风里动。
lines.en: Our manes move together in the wind.
It waits for me among the flowers.
We listen to the wood together.
Its green is paler than mine.

lines.zh: 我们坐在同一片草地上。
lines.en: We sit on the same meadow.
We'll evolve together, later on.
Flowers fall between us.
This moment is calm.
Tomorrow I'll wait here for it.
I pick it up gently.
Is this yours?
I nudge it to your boot.
I carry it carefully.
It feels a little soft.
I set it on the grass.
Could this go down?
I paw at it twice.
I hide it under the flowers.
I carry this in my mouth.
The flowers there are moving.

lines.zh: 我看见了它，圣光已经亮了。
lines.en: I see it; the holy light is up.
I push up onto four legs.
I've got my eyes on that spot.
The light I shoot is gentle.
My mane lifts and I move.
My mane has risen.
It's between two flower clumps.

lines.zh: 花丛那边，影子动了一下。
lines.en: By the flowers, a shadow moved.

lines.zh: 那丛花后面，有东西在喘。
lines.en: Behind the flowers something is breathing.
I've readied my move.

lines.zh: 我低低应了一声，走过去。
lines.en: I answer low and walk over.
I step forward over flower stems.

lines.zh: 花朵挡着我，我压低身子。
lines.en: The flowers hide me; I keep low.
The gap through the grass narrows.
It turns back; I freeze.
I shift one clump nearer.
My tail is held low.
When its hind legs slacken, I move.
I keep to the stems and close in.
From here I can pounce.
I hold my breath.
Now is the time.
My hind legs drive first.
I leap, forepaws landing first.
Green Pucchiemon, Holy Shoot.

lines.zh: 绿色的尾尖抽在它肋上。
lines.en: My green tail tip snaps its ribs.
Petals stick to its fur.
Petals fly up.

lines.zh: 我的绿鬃毛扫过它的眼睛。
lines.en: My green mane sweeps across its eyes.

lines.zh: 我跃起，前爪先落，它退了半步。
lines.en: I leap, forepaws first, and it gives half a step.
I keep this strength in reserve.

lines.zh: 绿色的触手一收，它倒了。
lines.en: Green tendrils retracted, and it fell.
I follow with another bite.
I let go and step off.
I shake the leaf bits from my mane.
I take shape among the flowers.
The wood glimmers and I appear.
The green Pucchiemon, here.
I land by the flower patch.

lines.zh: 我的绿色鬃毛慢慢展开。
lines.en: My green mane spreads slowly.

lines.zh: 花丛一晃，我从里头出来。
lines.en: The flowers sway; I come out of them.
The flowers here are fragrant.
I raise my head to you.
My data is steady.
I sit slowly and wait.
Petals scatter under my feet.
I come from the windswept forest.

lines.zh: 火焰舔过我的鬃毛，焦了。
lines.en: Flame licks my mane and singes it.
I fall from over the flowers.

lines.zh: 我四爪乱刨，水灌进毛里。
lines.en: I thrash; water soaks into my fur.

lines.zh: 花瓣被气浪卷起来，全乱了。
lines.en: The blast scatters the petals.

lines.zh: 箭尾插进花丛，我盯着它。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in the flowers; I stare at it.

lines.zh: 那道力冲进我的数据里。
lines.en: The force rushes into my data.
My data is draining.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我整个都缩起来。
lines.en: At the thunder, I curl up tight.
Nothing underfoot, nowhere to stand.
